knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Protectant on damp fabric traps moisture, so the seat is dried first.
Leather should feel natural, neither greasy nor glossy.
Liquid stays off the screen; the product goes onto the towel first.

practicalCriteria: Completes the interior sequence on a sample vehicle in order: mats, loose items, vacuum and brush, spot treatment, cleaning, protection.
Identifies the material of three surfaces and selects a product for each from its label.
Cleans a simulated screen without any liquid reaching the screen, and confirms the interior is dry at handover.
passRule: Sequence followed, materials matched to products, no liquid on screens or controls, and interior dry at handover. Observed by an assessor. Not an automotive or electrical licence.
stopWorkCriteria: Liquid sprayed onto a screen, control or airbag cover
